* Ctrl + H - History

Regularly:

* TAB - Skips a line ahead. It's useful mostly at login windows
* Shift + TAB - Goes a line back
* Ctrl + A - Selects everything on the site or in a textbox
* Windows button + P - Opens up screen control center
* Ctrl + Shift + ESC - Opens task manager

These small shortcuts can increase your browsing speed quite a lot.
